2. We will be scraping data from the NC DEQs Local Water Supply Planning website, specifically the Durham's 2024 Municipal Local Water Supply Plan (LWSP): 
 * Navigate to https://www.ncwater.org/WUDC/app/LWSP/search.php
 * Scroll down and select the LWSP link next to Durham Municipality. 
 * Note the web address: <https://www.ncwater.org/WUDC/app/LWSP/report.php?pwsid=03-32-010&year=2024>
 
Indicate this website as the as the URL to be scraped. (In other words, read the contents into an `rvest` webpage object.)

```{r set.the.scraping.website}
#2 Setting the LWSP website as the URL to be scraped
waterurl <- "https://www.ncwater.org/WUDC/app/LWSP/report.php?pwsid=03-32-010&year=2024"

durhamwater <- read_html(waterurl)
```

3. The data we want to collect are listed below:

* From the "1. System Information" section:
 * Water system name
 * PWSID
 * Ownership
 
* From the "3. Water Supply Sources" section:
 * Maximum Day Use (MGD) - for each month

In the code chunk below scrape these values, assigning them to four separate variables.

>HINT: The first value should be "Durham", the second "03-32-010", the third "Municipality", and the last should be a vector of 12 numeric values (represented as strings)".

```{r scrape.the.data}
#3 Scraping water system name/pwsid/ownership/maximum day use
water_name <- durhamwater %>% html_nodes('div+ table tr:nth-child(1) td:nth-child(2)') %>% html_text()
pwsid <- durhamwater %>% html_nodes('td tr:nth-child(1) td:nth-child(5)') %>% html_text()
ownership <- durhamwater %>% html_nodes('div+ table tr:nth-child(2) td:nth-child(4)') %>% html_text()
mgd <- durhamwater %>% html_nodes('th~ td+ td') %>% html_text()

water_name
pwsid
ownership
mgd
```

5. Create a line plot of the maximum daily withdrawals across the months for 2024, making sure, the months are presented in proper sequence.

```{r create.a.dataframe.from.scraped.data}
#4
#Creating the water_data dataframe with all of the scraped data
water_data <- data.frame(
  "Water System Name" = water_name,
  "PWSID" = pwsid,
  "Ownership" = ownership,
  "Maximum Day Use" = mgd
)

#Adding a column indicating the month to match the data in chronological order
water_data$Month <- c("Jan","May","Sep","Feb","Jun","Oct","Mar","Jul","Nov","Apr","Aug","Dec")

#Adding an additional column indicating the month and year
water_data$date <-
  c("2024-01","2024-05","2024-09","2024-02","2024-06","2024-10","2024-03","2024-7","2024-11","2024-04","2024-08","2024-12")

#Converting the new date column to reclassify it as 'date' data instead of characters
water_data <- water_data %>%
  mutate(date = ym(date))

#5 
#Created graph showing maximum day use by month throughout 2024.

mgd_graph <- 
  water_data %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = Maximum.Day.Use, group = 1)) +
  geom_line(color = "blue", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(title = "Maximum Daily Withdrawals by Month of Durham's Local Water Supply",
       x = "Months",
       y = "Maximum Day Use") +
  theme_minimal()

mgd_graph
```

6. Note that the PWSID and the year appear in the web address for the page we scraped. Construct a function with two inputs - "PWSID" and "year" - that:
  - Creates a URL pointing to the LWSP for that PWSID for the given year
  - Creates a website object and scrapes the data from that object (just as you did above)
  - Constructs a dataframe from the scraped data, mostly as you did above, but includes the PWSID and year provided as function inputs in the dataframe. 
  - Returns the dataframe as the function's output


```{r construct.a.scraping.function}
#6. 
scrape.it <- function(year, pwsid) {
  yearurl <- 
    ifelse(
      year == 2023 & pwsid == "03-32-010",
      'https://www.ncwater.org/WUDC/app/LWSP/report.php?pwsid=03-32-010&year=2024',
      paste0("https://www.ncwater.org/WUDC/app/LWSP/report.php?pwsid=",pwsid,"&year=",year,"")
  )
  print(yearurl)
  
  year_website <- read_html(yearurl)
  
  name <- year_website %>% html_nodes('div+table tr:nth-child(1) td:nth-child(2)') %>% html_text()
  pwsid_new <- year_website %>% html_nodes('td tr:nth-child(1) td:nth-child(5)') %>% html_text()
  ownership_new <- year_website %>% html_nodes('div+ table tr:nth-child(2) td:nth-child(4)') %>% html_text()
  mgd_new <- year_website %>% html_nodes('th~ td+ td') %>% html_text()
  
  year_df <- data.frame(
    "Water System Name" = name,
    "PWSID" = pwsid_new,
    "Ownership" = ownership_new,
    "Maximum Day Use" = mgd_new
)
  return(year_df)
}
```
